root_cause: Powerhouse Delivery Hygiene loaded only one open-PR page and used a small synchronous child-process output buffer. With many open PRs, GitHub CLI output could exceed the buffer and admission failed before candidate evaluation. The resulting recovery also exposed a governance risk: a predecessor may be closed as SUPERSEDED while its successor is still pending, which must never be interpreted as terminal success. A second systemic cause amplified the incident: stale queued workflow runs on branches without an open PR remained in the repository for days, consuming queue capacity and delaying current exact-head gates.
prevention_rule: Delivery admission must paginate the complete open-PR candidate set with an explicit bounded large output buffer. Supersession is lineage state only: it requires an explicit same-obligation successor and never constitutes LIVE_BEWEZEN. Terminal completion remains protected merge plus production/provider readback plus learning/skill writeback. Repository hygiene must run hourly and cancel only queued runs older than six hours when no open PR owns that branch head; main, current open-PR heads and in-progress work remain protected.
failed_approaches: Increasing the GitHub API output buffer alone reduced immediate overflow risk but still left open-PR discovery incomplete above one page.
Treating a closed predecessor as completion would conflate SUPERSEDED with terminal delivery.
fix: Use gh api --paginate --slurp for the open PR candidate set.
Raise the explicit bounded GitHub CLI buffer to 64 MiB for admission reads.
Keep explicit same-obligation Supersedes lineage and regression-test that predecessor blocking does not create terminal evidence.
Preserve successor admission only when predecessor lineage is proven.
Run the repository janitor hourly instead of daily.
Paginate all open PR discovery in the janitor.
Cancel queued runs older than six hours only when no open PR owns the branch; never use this TTL rule for in-progress runs or main.

evidence.original_failure: PR #2790 / PR #2795 delivery admission during high open-PR volume
evidence.observed_queue: Repository queue contained queued runs from 2026-09-12 while current delivery ran on 2026-09-24.

invariants: all open PR pages participate in admission candidate discovery
large open-PR response volume does not overflow the default child-process buffer
successor lineage requires explicit same-obligation Supersedes metadata
stale queued runs without open-PR authority are reaped after a bounded TTL
main, current open-PR heads and in-progress work are never removed by stale-queue TTL cleanup

terminal_rule: Do not mark this prevention LIVE_BEWEZEN until the successor is protected-merged and production/main readback proves the deployed lineage.
